name: UFortGameplayAbility__ClampAimYawToMaxFireAngle
signature: FRotator UFortGameplayAbility::ClampAimYawToMaxFireAngle(const FRotator& Desired, const FRotator& Reference) const
inc_or_decl:
// Wraps the yaw difference to [-180, 180] and, when its magnitude exceeds MaxYawAngleToFire, places the result at Reference yaw +/- MaxYawAngleToFire. Pitch and roll come from Desired.
FRotator ClampAimYawToMaxFireAngle(const FRotator& Desired, const FRotator& Reference) const;
